description: Governor's Office Western Province - Rules relating to procedure for the Conduct of Business at Meetings of the Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette contains rules and regulations (Pradeshiya Sabha (Procedure for the Conduct of Business at Meetings) Rules) that establish legal procedures for conducting business at local government meetings. It falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it deals with regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and statutory instruments governing administrative procedures, rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
